parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance for which you want to query the price. This parameter is required for upgrade scenarios and is used to obtain the instance configuration before the upgrade.

sub_parameters.name: Config
sub_parameters.description: The configuration of the Nth pricing module. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Format: "AA:aa,BB:bb", where AA and BB are the property codes of the pricing module, and aa and bb are the property values.

sub_parameters.name: ModuleCode
sub_parameters.description: The module code of the Nth pricing module.

sub_parameters.name: ModuleStatus
sub_parameters.description:
The change status of the pricing module. This parameter is required only when OrderType is set to Upgrade.
Valid values:
- 1: new.
- 2: changed. In upgrade scenarios, if the configuration of a pricing module changes, you must set this parameter to 2.

Default value: 1.

sub_parameters.name: Tag
sub_parameters.description: The identifier of a specific resource. This parameter is required only for upgrade or specification change scenarios of certain products. For example, for cloud disk specification changes, Tag specifies the ID of the specific cloud disk.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The order type. Valid values:
- NewOrder: new purchase.
- Renewal: renewal.
- Upgrade: upgrade.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: The product type. Whether this parameter is required depends on the pricing documentation of the specific product.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ServicePeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the service duration. Valid values:
- Year
- Month

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description: The subscription type. Valid values: Subscription.
